en.label: Present Simple
en.focus: habits and facts; third-person -s; do/does in questions and negations

en.label: Present Continuous
en.focus: actions happening now or temporary situations (am/is/are + -ing)

en.label: Satzstellung
en.focus: subject-verb-object order, no German verb-second inversion, adverbs of frequency before the main verb

en.label: Fragen und Verneinung
en.focus: do-support, question word order, short negations with not

en.label: Simple Past
en.focus: finished past events with a time reference, including irregular verbs

en.label: Past Continuous
en.focus: background action in progress interrupted by another past event

en.label: Present Perfect
en.focus: experience, result now, unfinished time with for/since, contrast with simple past

en.label: Zukunft (will / going to)
en.focus: predictions, plans and spontaneous decisions; present continuous for arrangements

en.label: Artikel
en.focus: a/an/the and zero article where German uses an article

en.label: Mengenwörter
en.focus: much/many, some/any, a few/a little, countable versus uncountable nouns

en.label: Steigerung
en.focus: comparatives and superlatives, as ... as, than

en.label: Präpositionen
en.focus: time and place prepositions and fixed verb/adjective prepositions (depend on, interested in)

en.label: Modalverben
en.focus: can, must, have to, should, might, need not, and their past forms

en.label: Bedingungssätze (if)
en.focus: first and second conditional with correct tense in each clause

en.label: Passiv
en.focus: be + past participle in the right tense, agent with by

en.label: Relativsätze
en.focus: who, which, that, whose, where, and omitting the relative pronoun

en.label: Gerund oder Infinitiv
en.focus: verbs followed by -ing or to-infinitive (enjoy doing, decide to do)

en.label: Phrasal Verbs
en.focus: common particle verbs and their object position (turn it off)

en.label: Feste Wortverbindungen
en.focus: natural collocations such as make a decision, do homework, take a photo

en.label: Past Perfect
en.focus: an earlier past action before another past event

en.label: Irreale Vergangenheit
en.focus: if + past perfect, would have + past participle; wish/regret structures

en.label: Indirekte Rede
en.focus: backshift of tenses, reporting verbs, reported questions without inversion

pt-BR.label: Presente
pt-BR.focus: regular and common irregular verbs in the present (ser, ter, ir, fazer)

pt-BR.label: Ser oder Estar
pt-BR.focus: permanent characteristics versus states and locations

pt-BR.label: Genus und Angleichung
pt-BR.focus: noun gender, article and adjective agreement in gender and number

pt-BR.label: Artikel und Verschmelzungen
pt-BR.focus: definite/indefinite articles and contractions do, na, pelo, ao

pt-BR.label: Fragen und Verneinung
pt-BR.focus: não placement, question words, intonation questions

pt-BR.label: Estar + Gerúndio
pt-BR.focus: ongoing actions (estou fazendo) in Brazilian usage

pt-BR.label: Pretérito Perfeito
pt-BR.focus: completed past events, regular and irregular forms

pt-BR.label: Pretérito Imperfeito
pt-BR.focus: habits and descriptions in the past, contrast with perfeito

pt-BR.label: Zukunft mit ir
pt-BR.focus: ir + infinitive for plans and predictions

pt-BR.label: Possessivpronomen
pt-BR.focus: meu/minha, seu/sua and dele/dela in Brazilian usage

pt-BR.label: Objektpronomen
pt-BR.focus: me, te, lhe, o/a and Brazilian pronoun placement (me dá)

pt-BR.label: Por oder Para
pt-BR.focus: cause, exchange and route versus purpose, recipient and deadline

pt-BR.label: Verben mit Präposition
pt-BR.focus: verb government such as gostar de, precisar de, pensar em

pt-BR.label: Reflexive Verben
pt-BR.focus: reflexive pronouns with verbs like lembrar-se, sentar-se

pt-BR.label: Steigerung
pt-BR.focus: mais/menos ... do que, tão ... quanto, irregular melhor/pior

pt-BR.label: Imperativ
pt-BR.focus: affirmative and negative commands in polite and informal registers

pt-BR.label: Relativsätze
pt-BR.focus: que, onde, quem, cujo

pt-BR.label: Subjuntivo Presente
pt-BR.focus: wishes, doubt and emotion after que (espero que você venha)

pt-BR.label: Hypothetische Sätze
pt-BR.focus: se + imperfect subjunctive with conditional (se eu tivesse, eu iria)

pt-BR.label: Futuro do Subjuntivo
pt-BR.focus: quando/se + future subjunctive (quando você chegar)

es.label: Presente
es.focus: regular and stem-changing verbs in the present

es.label: Ser oder Estar
es.focus: characteristics versus states and locations; hay versus estar

es.label: Genus und Angleichung
es.focus: articles, nouns and adjectives agreeing in gender and number

es.label: Fragen und Verneinung
es.focus: no placement, double negation (no ... nada), question words with accents

es.label: Gustar und ähnliche Verben
es.focus: indirect object construction (me gusta, me gustan, le encanta)

es.label: Pretérito Indefinido
es.focus: completed past events with irregular forms (fui, tuve, hice)

es.label: Pretérito Imperfecto
es.focus: habits and background in the past, contrast with indefinido

es.label: Pretérito Perfecto
es.focus: he hecho for recent past and experience in peninsular usage

es.label: Zukunft
es.focus: ir a + infinitive and simple future

es.label: Objektpronomen
es.focus: lo/la/le, se lo, placement before conjugated verbs and attached to infinitives

es.label: Por oder Para
es.focus: cause, exchange and route versus purpose, recipient and deadline

es.label: Präpositionen
es.focus: personal a and verb prepositions (pensar en, soñar con)

es.label: Reflexive Verben
es.focus: levantarse, acordarse de, change of meaning with se

es.label: Imperativ
es.focus: tú/usted commands, negative commands with subjunctive

es.label: Relativsätze
es.focus: que, quien, donde, lo que, cuyo

es.label: Subjuntivo
es.focus: wishes, doubt, emotion and cuando + subjunctive for the future

es.label: Hypothetische Sätze
es.focus: si + imperfect subjunctive with conditional (si tuviera, iría)

it.label: Presente
it.focus: regular and common irregular verbs in the present

it.label: Artikel und Präpositionen
it.focus: definite/indefinite articles and articulated prepositions (nel, della, sul)

it.label: Genus und Angleichung
it.focus: noun, article and adjective agreement in gender and number

it.label: Fragen und Verneinung
it.focus: non placement, non ... mai/niente/nessuno, question words

it.label: C'è / Ci sono
it.focus: existence with c'è and ci sono

it.label: Passato Prossimo
it.focus: auxiliary essere or avere and participle agreement with essere

it.label: Imperfetto
it.focus: habits and descriptions in the past, contrast with passato prossimo

it.label: Futuro Semplice
it.focus: future forms and future of probability

it.label: Piacere
it.focus: indirect object construction (mi piace, mi piacciono)

it.label: Possessivpronomen
it.focus: possessives with articles, without article for singular family members

it.label: Pronomen (lo, gli, ne, ci)
it.focus: direct and indirect object pronouns, combined pronouns, ne and ci

it.label: Reflexive Verben
it.focus: reflexive verbs including passato prossimo with essere

it.label: Imperativ
it.focus: tu/Lei commands, negative imperative with infinitive

it.label: Relativsätze
it.focus: che, cui with prepositions, il quale

it.label: Congiuntivo
it.focus: opinion, wish and doubt after che (penso che sia)

it.label: Hypothetische Sätze
it.focus: se + congiuntivo imperfetto with condizionale (se avessi, andrei)

nb.label: Presens
nb.focus: present tense ending -r for all persons

nb.label: Verb an zweiter Stelle
nb.focus: inversion after a fronted adverbial (I dag drar jeg)

nb.label: Fragen und Verneinung
nb.focus: question word order and ikke placement in main clauses

nb.label: Plural
nb.focus: indefinite and definite plural, irregular plurals

nb.label: Adjektivangleichung
nb.focus: -t for neuter, -e for plural and definite

nb.label: Doppelte Bestimmtheit
nb.focus: den/det/de + adjective + definite noun (den store bilen)

nb.label: Preteritum
nb.focus: weak and strong verbs in the past

nb.label: Possessivpronomen
nb.focus: possessive after the definite noun (bilen min)

nb.label: Modalverben und Infinitiv
nb.focus: modal verbs without å, other verbs with å + infinitive

nb.label: Nebensatzstellung
nb.focus: ikke and adverbs before the verb in subordinate clauses (at jeg ikke har)

nb.label: Präpositionen
nb.focus: på versus i for places and time expressions

nb.label: Relativsätze
nb.focus: som as subject or object, word order inside the clause
